scheme.ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
scheme.description: Launched 1 May 2016 in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh. Deposit-free LPG connection. Cash assistance: Rs 2,050 for 14.2 kg cylinder; Rs 1,300 for 5 kg cylinder. First LPG refill free. Stove (hotplate) free. Administered by Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas through OMCs.
scheme.voice_summary: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana gives a deposit-free LPG gas connection to adult women from poor households, with the first refill and a stove free.
benefits: Cash assistance of Rs 2050 for 14.2 kg cylinder deposit-free connection
Cash assistance of Rs 1300 for 5 kg cylinder connection
First LPG refill free + Stove (hotplate) free from OMCs
eligibility: Must have attained 18 years of age
No other LPG connection from any OMC should exist in the same household
Must belong to a poor household (deprivation declaration required)
documents: Aadhaar Card of Adult Woman Applicant
application_process: offline: Visit nearest LPG distributor showroom.
offline: Submit filled application form along with Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook, and 14-point declaration.
offline: Distributor verifies eligibility against OMC de-duplication database.
offline: Receive LPG cylinder, pressure regulator, hose pipe, and stove.
online: Visit pmuy.gov.in portal, select LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).
online: Submit online application form with Aadhaar and family ration card details.
exceptions: Any household already having an existing LPG connection in the name of any family member

catalog_descriptions.en: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana gives a deposit-free LPG gas connection to adult women from poor households, with the first refill and a stove free.
catalog_descriptions.hi: प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना गरीब परिवारों की वयस्क महिलाओं को जमा-मुक्त एलपीजी गैस कनेक्शन देती है, जिसमें पहला रिफिल और एक चूल्हा मुफ्त होता है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: பிரதம மந்திரி உஜ்வாலா யோஜனா ஏழைக் குடும்பங்களைச் சேர்ந்த வயது வந்த பெண்களுக்கு வைப்புத்தொகை இல்லாத எல்பிஜி எரிவாயு இணைப்பை வழங்குகிறது, இதில் முதல் முறையாக எரிவாயு நிரப்புதல் மற்றும் அடுப்பு இலவசமாக வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
